details: The Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged in its June 2026 policy meeting, maintaining the federal funds rate between 3.50% and 3.75%. However, the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) adopted a more hawkish tone, with updated projections indicating that several policymakers anticipate at least one more rate hike before the year-end. This "higher-for-longer" interest rate stance has strengthened the US dollar and reduced investor appetite for risk assets, including cryptocurrencies, leading to downward pressure on Bitcoin, which slipped below $66,000 following the announcement.
title: Federal Reserve Signals Hawkish Outlook, Pressuring Crypto Markets

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) raised its key interest rate by 25 basis points, bringing it to 2.25%. While this move was largely anticipated by financial markets, the absence of signals for further aggressive monetary tightening contributed to a weakening of the Euro against the US Dollar. This shift can indirectly influence euro-based cryptocurrency inflows and potentially support dollar-denominated crypto assets.
title: European Central Bank Raises Key Interest Rate

details: The European Union has confirmed new Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations set to take effect in July 2027. These rules will prohibit anonymous crypto accounts and privacy-focused cryptocurrencies such as Monero and Zcash within the EU. Additionally, a €10,000 cash payment cap will be enforced. This regulatory tightening will require exchanges to delist privacy coins, potentially affecting liquidity and user privacy in the European crypto market.
title: EU to Ban Privacy Coins and Anonymous Accounts from July 2027

details: Producer prices in Germany increased by 2.2% year-on-year in May 2026, accelerating from April's 1.7% rise and marking the fastest increase since May 2023. This surge was primarily driven by higher costs for intermediate goods and energy, particularly a significant rise in mineral oil prices attributed to the Middle East conflict. Persistent inflationary pressures in major economies like Germany could reinforce a hawkish stance from global central banks, potentially leading to prolonged higher interest rates and a reduced appetite for speculative assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: German Producer Prices Hit Three-Year High, Fueling Inflation Concerns
